resources.string: cliamp-x is an independent project, a fork of cliamp by Bjarne Øverli. It is not the official cliamp: report cliamp-x issues in its own repository.
The app (this APK) is distributed under GPL-3.0 because it includes youtubedl-android. The cliamp-x source code is MIT.

cliamp-x collects no data: it has no telemetry, analytics or ads, and no server of its own. Your YouTube Music session, your music, your playlists and your settings stay on the phone. The app only talks to the services it uses: YouTube Music, GitHub (app and yt-dlp updates), the site of each font you download, LRCLIB and NetEase (lyrics), SponsorBlock, the radios and links you open, and ListenBrainz or Last.fm if you connect an account. The log leaves the phone only if you send it.
Saves cliamp.log and the app log to a text file and opens Share. Nothing is sent by itself; check the file first: it lists the titles you played.
